title: 22 Cadogan Road, Dublin 3, Fairview, Dublin 3, D03NY00
seoTitle: 22 Cadogan Road, Dublin 3, Fairview, Dublin 3, D03NY00
description:
MOVEHOME ESTATE AGENTS are honoured to present a truly charming mid-terraced Edwardian red-brick period residence, beautifully restored and modernised with great flair and vision in recent years. 22 Cadogan Road was constructed circa 1906 and occupies an enviable position in the heart of Fairview Village. This exceptional home offers a wonderful blend of timeless period elegance, generous proportions and modern-day versatility. Behind its handsome red-brick façade lies an exceptionally appealing 2/3-bedroom residence extending to approximately 110 m² / 1,184 sq. ft. arranged over five different levels.

Throughout the property, original architectural detail has been carefully retained and sensitively complemented by thoughtful contemporary improvements. The result is a home of real distinction, combining immense period character with classic contemporary style and all the comforts and conveniences of modern living.

From the moment you enter, the warmth and character of this fine home are immediately apparent. The welcoming entrance hall features the original staircase, while a beautifully crafted handmade timber front door incorporates exquisite Edwardian-design stained-glass panels by Evan Connon Stained Glass. The door has been sensitively retrofitted into the original 1906 door frame and surround, creating a wonderful first impression while preserving the character of the original façade.

The entrance hall leads to two superb interconnecting reception rooms, each beautifully proportioned and retaining an impressive array of period features, including restored tiled Edwardian fireplaces, original timber floorboards and enviably high ceilings. The interconnected living and dining spaces are arranged over two different levels, creating a wonderfully versatile environment for both relaxed everyday living and entertaining. The warmth of the original architecture is further enhanced using carefully selected materials and finishes, including salvaged 100-year-old pine flooring sourced from The Victorian Kitchen Company, period-style radiators, traditional coving from Parnell Mouldings and elegant Little Greene wallpaper.To the rear, the kitchen is bright, stylish and exceptionally practical, with excellent storage and preparation space together with direct access to the garden. Attractive tiled flooring and subway-tiled splashbacks provide a timeless backdrop, while custom-made metal and birch plywood shelving adds a distinctive contemporary touch. A reclaimed scaffold-board worktop further complements the kitchen's characterful aesthetic, creating a space that is both highly functional and full of personality. Cleverly designed bespoke built-in storage beneath the stairs, together with custom dining-room storage, ensures that practicality has been carefully considered without compromising the home's period character.

The bedrooms continue the property's wonderful blend of old and new, with original fireplaces retained in both bedrooms, adding a sense of warmth and authenticity that is increasingly difficult to find. Throughout the house there are double glazed sliding sash windows, allowing an abundance of natural light. Granite windowsills provide another handsome period detail. The bathroom which is located on the first floor return is exquisite with a stand-alone bath, separate power shower and Italian tiles throughout.

Outside, the original front railings and gate remain, preserving the property's handsome streetscape and connection to its Edwardian origins. To the rear, the garden provides a private and versatile outdoor space, with a remote-controlled awning and wall-mounted electric heater creating a particularly enjoyable area for outdoor dining and entertaining. A built-in storage shed provides valuable additional storage and completes this well-considered outdoor space.

Every aspect of this remarkable residence has been thoughtfully considered, from the preservation of its original architectural details to the introduction of bespoke modern features. The result is a home that feels both authentic and highly liveable, where period elegance sits comfortably alongside contemporary design and functionality.

Cadogan Road enjoys an enviable setting in the heart of Fairview, with Fairview Park, local shops, cafés, restaurants, pubs and a host of amenities all within easy reach. Fairview and neighbouring Drumcondra offer an excellent selection of recreational, social and sporting facilities. Westwood Fitness Centre and Clontarf DART station are within walking distance, while Dublin city centre is just a few minutes' drive away.
The M50, M1, Dublin Airport, East Point Business Park and Beaumont Hospital are all readily accessible, further enhancing the convenience of this superb location.

Early viewing is essential to fully appreciate all that this wonderful home has to offer and is available by appointment with MOVEHOME ESTATE AGENTS on 01 88 44 690.
